definitions.gloss: saliva swallowed involuntarily from anticipation, desire, or nervousness
definitions.explanation: Saliva that one swallows instinctively, typically when seeing delicious food, feeling greedy anticipation, or experiencing nervous tension.

examples.japanese: {生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
おいしそうな⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I gulped at the sight of the delicious-looking cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧{生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I waited nervously for the results, swallowing hard with tension.

notes:
USAGE:
{生唾|なまつば} almost always appears in the expression {生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to swallow saliva), which conveys either eager anticipation or nervous tension. It is not used as a neutral medical or scientific term for saliva — ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧ is the clinical term.

FORMS:
⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, involuntary) + {唾|つば} (saliva).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to gulp, to swallow hard
- {生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み{込|こ}む→飲み込む：04403_nomikomu⟧: to gulp down saliva
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{生唾|なまつば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to involuntarily gulp
